meaning: An informal way to describe something as very good, or say something went very well.
context: Casual conversation. A stylistic option, not a correction of genial or estupendo. Not exclusive to Barcelona.
source_label: RAE · Diccionario de la lengua española

meaning: Spanish and Catalan are both official languages in Barcelona.
context: Keep Spanish practice in Spanish. Identify Catalan explicitly if it comes up; never treat it as a Spanish dialect or assume every resident has the same language preference.
source_label: Barcelona City Council · 10 tips to feel at home
